decision_needed.question: The LB840 Fund budget schedule shows 'Other income' 164,606 that does not appear in the fund's GAAP revenues (p5 LB840 revenues are only sales tax and interest). Is it repayments of LB840 loans (Loan Repayments)?

notes: GAAP (modified accrual governmental funds, accrual proprietary funds), done as FY2023. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5): fund balance 9,893,655 + revenues 7,595,438 - expenditures 6,602,940 + transfers in 416,713 - transfers out 925,330 = 10,377,536. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet Total 'Cash and cash equivalents' 1,380,464 (p4); investments 1,415,258 separate; restricted cash/investments and county treasurer cash are further lines. Business-type from the proprietary statement (p8) Total enterprise column (Internal Service Fund excluded): 24,152,833 + revenues 12,067,666 - expenses 9,728,343 (total business-type expenses printed p2) + total transfers 494,572 (transfer to Community Development Agency (14,045) + transfers from other funds 508,617) = 26,986,728. Utility 'Other revenue' is charges for services because the Statement of Activities charges for services equal each utility's total operating revenues. Proprietary cash flows from the Total column (p10). Detail: budgetary-basis schedules for General, Street, LB840 and Debt Service funds (p13-p16; zero-actual Debt Service 'Other revenue' line, budget 211,641, omitted as in FY2023), nonmajor combining statement per fund (p17); utility funds have no budget schedules, so no business-type detail (as FY2023/FY2024). No deferred outflows/inflows printed. Component units excluded. Read pages 1-17 of 17
